out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided clean policy

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed an employee drinking from a bottle of water in the cook area
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS provided training.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front hand-sink being used hold dirty spoons.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM removed spoons and clean the handsink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs stored over raw vegetables in unit # 1
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated raw shell eggs to the bottom shelf

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean between Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Equipment food contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned between working with raw foods and ready-to-eat foods. Observed the cutting board attached to the prep cooler with visible drops of blood present. The surface had not been properly washed, rinsed, and sanitized after being used to support another cutting board used to cut raw lamb
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned each time there is a change from working with raw foods to working with ready to eat foods. CFM properly washed, rinsed, and sanitized the both cutting boards

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: raw marinated chicken in unit # 1 (~18hrs) at 52F, raw ground beef, raw chicken, Tzatziki sauce, cut tomato in unit # 3 (~18hrs) at 49, 45, 45, 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM Discarded raw marinated chicken from unit # 1, raw ground beef, raw chicken, Tzatziki sauce from unit # 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Homemade tomato jam on counter at 60F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM stored tomato jam in unit # 4

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: beef skewers, lamb
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CFM will place an asterisks next to the COP SIS and AEGEAN KEBAB.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Squeeze bottles and seasoning containers were found with no labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM named label squeeze bottles and seasoning containers.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths store in counter and bucket with no sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.CFM stored wet wiping clothes in sanitizer solution. Smyrna Restaurant (Inspection Date: 07/01/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed ice scoop stored directly on the ice
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM stored the ice scoop properly on designated hanger

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: unit # 3 at 43F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will adjust/repair the unit and do not use it until is adjusted/ repaired.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed two burned-out light bulbs in the extraction (ventilation) hood above the cooking area
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM will replaced burn-out light bulbs.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed QUAT test kit producing inaccurate readings when compared to Environmental Health Specialist (EHS) test results. The facility’s test kit displayed a ppm (parts per million) reading inconsistent with actual sanitizer strength, which may be due to expired test strips, water damage, or improper storage of the test kit.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to a faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin. Observed the sanitizer compartment plumbing using a corrugated hose instead of approved PVC piping. The hose was in contact with the floor of the floor sink and lacked the required air gap
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. Smyrna Restaurant (Inspection Date: 07/01/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Wall/Ceiling Coverings Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Wall and ceiling covering materials are not easily cleanable. Observed ripped and damaged faux tile wall panels in the food preparation area. The torn surface is no longer smooth, durable, or easily cleanable, making it difficult to sanitize and increasing the risk of harborage for dirt, moisture, and pests
violations.corrective_action: Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are easily cleanable. CFM will replace the panel and attached to make it easily cleanable.
